name: bring up eth0 statically
cmd:
ip link set eth0 up && ip addr add 192.168.86.100/24 dev eth0 && ip route add default via 192.168.86.1 && printf '192.0.2.1 api.anthropic.com
192.0.2.2 api.openai.com
192.0.2.3 generativelanguage.googleapis.com
192.0.2.4 api.x.ai
' >> /etc/hosts && echo brought-up

name: link and route state
cmd: ip addr show eth0 | head -4; ip route; echo --- hosts ---; cat /etc/hosts

name: no DNS at all: resolv.conf absent
write hosted config, NO KEY
cmd: mkdir -p /root/.config/temur && printf '%s' '{"provider":"anthropic","max_tokens":4096,"anthropic":{"base_url":"https://api.anthropic.com","model":"claude-sonnet-5","context_window":200000}}' > /root/.config/temur/config.json && echo config-written && echo '--- config has no key: ---' && cat /root/.config/temur/config.json
